resources.string: Optional device admin for locking the device and turning off the screen when the clock timer expires. Requests only the force-lock policy.

Immediate screen-off when the timer expires requires you to enable optional, lock-only device admin access. This access only allows the app to lock the device. A system lock may require your PIN, pattern or password to unlock.
Unable to open the screen-off permission settings. You can try again or continue without this optional permission.
Without lock-only device admin access, the clock exits when the timer expires. The screen then turns off according to the normal system screen timeout.
Lock-only device admin is enabled. The timer can lock the device and turn off the screen.
Lock-only device admin is not enabled.
Lock-only device admin is not supported on this device.
Unlock your device before enabling screen-off permission.
The clock has closed because immediate screen-off is unavailable. The display will switch off according to your system screen timeout.
